WIDEN.gloss: become broader or wider or more extensive
WIDEN.definition: Become broader or wider or more extensive.

WIDE.gloss: having great extent from one side to the other
WIDE.definition: Having great (or a certain) extent from one side to the other.

WIND.gloss: air moving from an area of high pressure to an area of low pressure
WIND.definition: Air moving (sometimes with considerable force) from an area of high pressure to an area of low pressure.
WIND.example: Trees bent under the fierce winds.

DINE.example: We often dine with friends in this restaurant.

NEW.definition: Not of long duration; having just (or relatively recently) come into being or been made or acquired or discovered.

END.gloss: either extremity of something that has length
END.definition: Either extremity of something that has length.

WIN.gloss: be the winner in a contest or competition
WIN.definition: Be the winner in a contest or competition; be victorious.
WIN.example: He won the Gold Medal in skating.

DIE.gloss: pass from physical life and lose all bodily attributes and functions necessary to…
DIE.definition: Pass from physical life and lose all bodily attributes and functions necessary to sustain life.
